claims.text: The no-show fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 only if all four limbs hold, and limb (b) requires the gps_trace itself to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the 21:10:20 'arrived' event. The only artifact that could do so is EV-GPS-09109, and it is MISSING: admissibility status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (severity BLOCKING), no payload. Per POL-GEN-02(3) a MISSING artifact has weight 0.0 and can carry no fact. The driver's own counterparty statement concedes 'the GPS export is unavailable.' Limb (b) is therefore unevidenced, and the conjunctive charge fails at the second limb.

POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have ARRIVED only where the gps_trace contains at least three consecutive fixes accurate to 25 m or better inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup pin at Woodlands MRT. With EV-GPS-09109 MISSING at weight 0.0 there is not a single qualifying in-radius fix on this record, so no deemed arrival exists and POL-NS-01(b) fails on POL-NS-02's own terms. I do not overstate this: an absent trace is not proof the driver was elsewhere. But the condition is drafted conjunctively and the required artifact is the driver's to produce; absence of the very evidence the clause names cannot discharge that limb.

Independently of arrival, POL-NS-01(c) measures the TRANSPORT_HUB minimum dwell of 300 seconds from the FIRST qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap, and POL-NS-06 defines the effective in-geofence dwell the same way. The 5.3 minutes recorded in trip_record.wait_time_min is the driver's own marker and runs from his arrival tap; it is not an in-geofence measurement. With EV-GPS-09109 missing there is no in-geofence interval from which an effective dwell can be computed, so limb (c) is as unevidenced as limb (b), and POL-NS-06 cannot be satisfied on this record either.

The driver has no route to bridge that gap. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a populated traffic_advisory covering the pickup road carries type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING: weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (severity BLOCKING), no payload. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable, and POL-NS-06 itself says a MISSING advisory cannot be asserted to exonerate anyone. A missing advisory is citable as an absence, and here it closes the only accumulation door the clause opens.

If the Judge prefers to treat the absent trace as leaving arrival merely undecided rather than failed, POL-GEN-02(2) still caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact - 0.0 for EV-GPS-09109 - which is far below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation to a human reviewer. Escalation is terminal and holds the SGD 6.00 rather than collecting or refunding it, so even on that reading the rider is not made to carry a charge the platform has not substantiated, and the reviewer can settle it by obtaining the missing GPS export.

I do not press POL-NS-04, and I say so rather than stretch it. The rider's 21:11:30 message ('I am at the bay and cannot see your car') is a locating statement within limb (a) - it is expressly a statement that he cannot see the vehicle - but the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45, fifteen seconds later, so the 120 second silence requirement of limb (b) is not met and the clause does not apply. The rider's case rests on the missing GPS artifact, not on this clause.

The behaviour-based escalation triggers are not engaged on either side: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and neither rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d nor driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d exceeds 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. Any escalation here is driven solely by the absent deciding artifact and the confidence floor, which is exactly the open question a reviewer should settle - whether the driver's GPS export can be produced at all.

claims.text: The rider's contact-based route to a refund, POL-NS-04, is closed on its own terms. Even treating limb (a) as met - the rider's 21:11:30 message 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' is a coordinating message - limb (b) fails: the chat log shows the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45, only 15 seconds later and far inside the 120-second window POL-NS-04(b) allows. POL-NS-04 therefore does not apply and yields no full refund.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 cannot help the rider either. It is measured from the gps_trace rider_track, and that trace is MISSING: EV-GPS-09109 retains its identifier but has no payload, carries weight 0.0 and fired MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the test is undecidable - which POL-NS-04 itself makes neutral rather than adverse, an absent rider_track being neither presence nor absence. It cannot place the rider at the bay, and it cannot be turned against the driver.

POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) cannot be run. It requires a GPS fix matched to the arrival timestamp showing the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more. The gps_trace is MISSING - EV-GPS-09109 has no payload, is tagged MISSING_ARTIFACT with BLOCKING severity and carries weight 0.0, and under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact can carry no fact. No false-arrival finding can be made against the driver, and none may be inferred from an artifact that does not exist.

POL-NS-06 cannot be run either. It refunds a shortfall computed as the effective in-geofence dwell from the gps_trace, corrected where necessary under POL-NS-05. With the trace MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) there is no measured dwell, no shortfall in seconds and no arithmetic on which to order a refund. The rider cannot state a measured dwell below the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum because no dwell is measured at all.

POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) is likewise unavailable. It requires the gps_trace to show the driver stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin, and the trace is MISSING (weight 0.0). Its venue-identity corroboration needs a gps_point.venue_id and a trip_record.pickup venue_id, and no GPS fixes exist. The rider cannot convert 'I cannot see your car' into a refund without the trace.

On the evidence that does exist, the limbs of POL-NS-01 that do not depend on the absent trace are satisfied. The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:10:20 (limb (a)), and records the trip terminated by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW (limb (d)) - one of the three reason codes that limb recognises - with no boarding event. The platform's own arrival indication is corroborated by the SYSTEM message 'Your driver has arrived' at 21:10:21.

The only timestamps on record bracket a hold at least as long as the TRANSPORT_HUB minimum: arrived_at 21:10:20 to cancelled_at 21:15:40 is 320 seconds, consistent with trip_record.wait_time_min of 5.3 minutes, against the 300-second minimum the fee_schedule sets for TRANSPORT_HUB. POL-NS-01(c) would measure dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the marker, but no trace exists to recompute that start, and nothing in the record pushes the hold below the minimum; POL-NS-05, the clause that corrects a false marker, has no GPS on which to run.

The chat log corroborates presence and a held position rather than an abandoned pickup: the driver posted 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40, the rider answered at 21:11:30 that she could not see the car, and the driver responded 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45 - all inside the waiting window, with nothing suggesting he left the bay before cancelling at 21:15:40. That is not the early-tap or premature-cancel conduct POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 were drafted against.

The amount charged survives arithmetic scrutiny. fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is SGD 6.00, exactly the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule - the transport-hub dimension produces the figure. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no basis to disturb the amount.

No escalation trigger fires against the driver or on the pair. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb - both limbs must hold and neither does, so nothing is withheld on this record. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) do not fire either.

The traffic advisory is citable by its absence. EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) and no advisory covers this pickup road and waiting window. POL-NS-06 limb (i) can only be reached through a populated advisory, so that route is unavailable to the rider, and nothing on record documents a kerb restriction, closure or incident that would explain a driver unable to hold the bay.

The present payment state should stand. fare_breakdown shows payment_status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00 and total_charged SGD 6.00, and the rider has carried no refund route: POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 each require a gps_trace fact this record does not contain, the trace at EV-GPS-09109 being MISSING at weight 0.0. Under POL-GEN-03 that is precisely the disposition NO_ACTION describes - the filing party's claim unsupported by the evidence and the charge left as it presently is. If the judge instead finds the geofence and dwell question undetermined because the sole artifact that could carry it is absent, the correct disposition is escalation under POL-NS-09, not a refund: escalation holds the disputed fee rather than refunding it and so does not vindicate the rider's claim.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute cannot be decided on the record, so I am sending it to a human reviewer instead of picking a side.

The no-show fee under POL-NS-01 is chargeable only if all four conditions hold together. Two of them are confirmed by the trip record: the driver's 'arrived' event at 21:10:20 (condition (a)), and the trip terminated by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event (condition (d)). The other two depend entirely on the GPS trace, and there is no GPS trace. Condition (b) requires the gps_trace to place the car inside the pickup geofence (150 m at this TRANSPORT_HUB pin) at or before 21:10:20; condition (c) requires a continuous 300-second in-geofence dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival marker. EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING - no payload, MISSING_ARTIFACT at BLOCKING severity, weight_multiplier 0.0 - and a missing artifact can carry no fact. The driver's own statement that 'the GPS export is unavailable' confirms the gap.

Because the artifact those two tests read is absent, conditions (b) and (c) are undecided - neither passed nor failed. An undecided limb supports neither the fee (which needs all four conditions to hold) nor a refund (which would need the geofence test to run and find no qualifying in-radius fix). The rider's other routes fail the same way: POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker), POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall), POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) and POL-NS-04 (unanswered rider contact) each require a GPS fact this record does not contain. POL-NS-04 is closed on its own terms in any event: the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' 15 seconds after the rider's 21:11:30 message, far inside the 120-second silence limb (b) allows, so it yields no refund regardless of the missing trace.

I have not used the chat log to bridge the gap. The driver's 'I am at the private-hire bay' and 'I am here beside the sign' are his own assertions inside the waiting window, and the rider's answer is that she could not see the car; where the GPS test admitted no reading at all, the chat is standing in for the test rather than corroborating it, so it neither lifts the confidence cap nor stops the missing trace being the sole evidence for the deciding fact. The counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier and so enters neither side of the cap.

Two things are settled. First, the amount is correct: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of SGD 6.00 is exactly the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule - the transport-hub dimension produces the figure - so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect and nothing to disturb; the charge is PENDING with SGD 0.00 refunded. Second, no behaviour-based trigger fires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb, so both limbs fail and none is withheld; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d exceeds 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. I therefore reach no driver compensation under POL-NS-07, and I reject the argument that the charge should simply stand: NO_ACTION under POL-NS-07 describes the disposition of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which here it cannot be, the GPS being absent.

The deciding fact is carried only by an artifact at weight 0.0, so the ruling's confidence is capped at 0.0, below the 0.70 floor. The case escalates under POL-NS-09(a), and independently under POL-NS-09(e) because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired. Escalation is terminal and replaces any money outcome: the SGD 6.00 is held - neither collected nor refunded - while review is pending. The specific question for the reviewer is whether the driver's GPS export for the 20:58-21:15 window can be produced; if it can, the geofence and effective-dwell tests under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 can be run and the fee will either stand or be refunded on the ordinary clauses. No finding is made against either party's honesty.
